module purpose: Top-level TRNG IP that exposes a neoTRNG entropy generator and a FIFO to a bus: it decodes bus reads/writes to control the generator (enable, FIFO clear), forwards neoTRNG output bytes into an internal FIFO, and returns status (FIFO available, FIFO size, sim mode) and random bytes on bus_rsp_o.

use-case flows.value: Write control bits (enable, fifo_clr) into the TRNG control registers
Enable bit flows into neoTRNG as sample_en and starts/stops sampling
neoTRNG produces bytes (data_o, valid_o) that are presented to the FIFO inputs and written into the FIFO
Bus read returns either zero or the FIFO read-data word (fifo.rdata) depending on fifo.avail and read address
Bus read of control/status returns enable, FIFO size, sim-mode and fifo.avail fields
Reset forces control registers and internal sampling state to known defaults (bus_rsp_o, enable, fifo_clr at top-level; debias and sample counters inside neoTRNG)

conceptual assets.concept: Peripheral write decision that sets TRNG control bits (the bus write that stores enable and fifo_clr)
conceptual assets.reasoning: Bus writes gated by bus_req_i.stb and bus_req_i.rw assign the control bits: in the bus_access process a write branch runs when bus_req_i.stb='1' and bus_req_i.rw='1' (lines 103-106). The analyser records show bus_req_i.stb GATES those writes (bus_req_i.stb occurrence 3, GATES at line 103, targets include enable and fifo_clr) and bus_req_i.data SOURCES the written fields (bus_req_i.data occurrence 2 -> enable at line 105; occurrence 3 -> fifo_clr at line 106). Integrity of this write decision is required because these writes update the module's stored settings (enable, fifo_clr) that control sampling and FIFO clearing (map records cited above, lines 103-106).

conceptual assets.concept: TRNG enable state (the stored enable bit that starts/stops sampling)
conceptual assets.reasoning: The enable bit is captured into the 'enable' register on writes and reset (enable <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_en_c) at line 105; reset forces '0' at line 95). The map records show bus_req_i.data SOURCES -> enable (occurrence 2, line 105) and that 'enable' is a register CLOCKED_BY clk_i (enable occurrence 3, CLOCKED_BY at line 105). That stored enable is connected to the neoTRNG instance (connection at line 137) and enters neoTRNG as enable_i which CARRIES to sample_en inside neoTRNG (neoTRNG.enable_i occurrence 2, CARRIES at line 354). The neoTRNG sampling_control then uses that value to gate sampling (line 354). The integrity of the stored enable therefore determines whether sampling runs.

conceptual assets.concept: FIFO-clear control (the stored fifo_clr bit that forces the FIFO clear signal)
conceptual assets.reasoning: Writes set fifo_clr (fifo_clr <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_fifo_clr_c) at line 106) and reset clears it (line 94). The map shows bus_req_i.data SOURCES -> fifo_clr (bus_req_i.data occurrence 3, line 106) and fifo_clr is stored as a register CLOCKED_BY clk_i (fifo_clr occurrence 4, CLOCKED_BY at line 106). fifo.clear is driven from enable= '0' or fifo_clr = '1' (assignment at line 170) and is connected to the FIFO clear input (rnd_pool_fifo_inst.clear_i connection at line 157). Corrupting this stored control affects the FIFO clear signal and thus the availability of stored entropy.

conceptual assets.concept: Random output bytes (entropy) produced by neoTRNG and delivered to consumers via the FIFO and bus
conceptual assets.reasoning: neoTRNG forms bytes in sample_sreg and presents them on its data_o/valid_o outputs which are wired into the FIFO input and then read back on fifo.rdata for bus return. RTL assignments and maps: sample_sreg is registered (sample_sreg CLOCKED_BY clk_i at occurrence 3, line 357) and is copied to neoTRNG.data_o (neoTRNG.data_o COPIES sample_sreg at neoTRNG occurrence 2, line 366). neoTRNG.valid_o (occurrence 2, line 367) is DERIVES_FROM sample_cnt and is connected to FIFO write enable (neoTRNG_inst.valid_o -> fifo.we at line 138; top-level fifo.we connection at lines 138/162). The FIFO's read output arrives as fifo.rdata (rnd_pool_fifo_inst.rdata_o -> fifo.rdata connection at occurrence 3, line 166) and is copied to bus_rsp_o.data on reads when fifo.avail allows (bus_rsp_o.data COPIES fifo.rdata at bus_rsp_o.data occurrence 8, line 117). Integrity of these values as they move along these edges is established by the RTL assignments and connections cited above (lines 138-139, 161-163, 366, 367, 166, 117).

conceptual assets.concept: FIFO available flag (fifo.avail) used to select returning data versus zeros
conceptual assets.reasoning: The bus read logic returns ctrl_avail based on fifo.avail and also uses fifo.avail to select whether to return zeros or fifo.rdata (lines 112, 115-117). The analyser records show fifo.avail is driven by the FIFO sub-unit (rnd_pool_fifo_inst.avail_o -> fifo.avail connection at fifo.avail occurrence 4, line 167) and bus_rsp_o.data copies fifo.avail into the control read field (bus_rsp_o.data occurrence 6, COPIES at line 112). Corruption of fifo.avail would change the read selection and reported availability (map records and lines cited).

conceptual assets.concept: Debiasing state (debias_state) that controls acceptance of debiased bits into the sampling path
conceptual assets.reasoning: neoTRNG debiasing logic toggles debias_state and then debias_valid is computed from debias_state and debias_sreg (debias_state and debias_sreg(1) xor debias_sreg(0) at lines 334, 341). The analyser shows debias_state is a clocked register (debias_state occurrence 3, CLOCKED_BY at line 336) and is used to gate debias_valid (GATES record at line 341). The RTL therefore establishes that debias_state is an internal decision/state that the sampling flow depends on; its integrity affects which bits are admitted to sample_sreg.

conceptual assets.concept: Sample-byte counter (sample_cnt) that determines when a full sampled byte is valid
conceptual assets.reasoning: sample_cnt is incremented when debias_valid='1' and controls when sample_sreg becomes a complete byte and valid_o is asserted (sampling_control and valid_o assignment: lines 358-361, 366-367). The map records sample_cnt as a clocked register (sample_cnt occurrence 6, CLOCKED_BY at line 359) and shows sample_cnt SOURCES valid_o (map record at line 367). The RTL thus establishes sample_cnt as the stored sequencing state whose corruption would change when bytes are emitted.
